count_method: Whitespace-delimited tokens, including all report metadata, headings, diagram labels, caption and note; punctuation-only separators included conservatively. References excluded. Counting each hyphen-separated element separately gives 1912; adding five page numbers gives 1917. Diagram text taken from its complete source because the embedded figure is an image.

visual_review.1: Title and report text readable; no overflow.
visual_review.2: Reflection and ethics text readable; no clipping.
visual_review.3: Recommendations and final reflection fit; footer clear.
visual_review.4: Landscape blueprint: all 30 cells, six stages, three boundaries, F1-F5, W, arrows, legend, standards and note visible; no overlapping labels.
visual_review.5: Six APA references, hanging indents, consistent italics and active links.

links.note: The exporter decodes parentheses in the Carrefour 2023 URL. Both encodings resolve to the same PDF.

citation_audit: All six references cited. Corporate author/year and book author/year match. Wirtz (2023) precedes Wirtz et al. (2018) because a single-author entry precedes multiple-author entries with the same first author.
content_checks: No invented visit, interview, consent, measured pilot result or participant contribution.
Documented country/date initiatives separated from proposed UAE design.
F1-F5 identifiers match report, figure and controls.
No draft markers or empty sections in final files.
Numbers are explicitly proposed pilot standards.
Physical replenishment is frontstage; stockroom verification and task ownership are backstage.
limitations: Evaluation is a research-supported proposal, not an operational audit or measured customer study. Grading and group contribution evidence remain outside these artifact checks.
